scope: isolated compiler artifact; no shared-source edit, commit, L3, FireSim, or queue action

semantic_contract.native_subset: identity accumulator/output/per-channel scales plus zero per-channel bias; optional ReLU and narrow i8
semantic_contract.proof_scope: exact for every i32 accumulator; in-range integers are exactly representable in f32 and out-of-range values saturate identically
semantic_contract.native_bias_order_guard: an i32 accumulator-unit bias, when used by the generic LOOP_CONV interface, must be the first epilogue stage before scaling and activation

includes: affine im2col, native scalar, dynamic-weight bridge, host workspace, and schedule regressions

warm_reentrant_exact_micro_ab.protocol: same ELF process: one complete untimed warm invocation then one measured invocation
warm_reentrant_exact_micro_ab.performance_role: focused Spike proxy demonstrating real code generation; not FPGA performance evidence

refusal_interpretation.non_residual_pt2e_chains: 32 reach the exact chain but carry runtime/nonidentity scale and therefore retain the existing host pass
refusal_interpretation.residual_paths: 20 require a second tensor operand and are outside this non-residual change
refusal_interpretation.structural_ends: the stem/maxpool path and terminal FC do not have the admitted terminal chain
refusal_interpretation.all_convolution_native_audit: all 53 captured PT2E convolutions also have per-channel f32 weight scales and non-integer f32 biases; no bias is an exact accumulator-unit offset

resnet50_exact_ab.full_model_spike_ab_reason: the target and object are byte-identical, so a new run cannot distinguish the candidate

existing_host_fusion_explanation.mechanism: the canonical source planner groups each single-use conv-to-bias/ReLU/QDQ slice into one host segment and the host emitter lowers it as one fused traversal
existing_host_fusion_explanation.why_analysis_only_task_fusion_changed_no: changing task ownership did not change the existing emitted fused host loop, full-width accumulator MVOUT, or required device-to-host fence
existing_host_fusion_explanation.why_this_resnet_target_stays_identical: every native narrowing candidate failed the exact runtime-scale/bias capability proof, so the physical schedule and existing host pass were retained

transferred_q535_identity_evidence.basis: candidate ResNet object SHA-256 equals the exact object measured by q535

sequential_four_model_compile_gate.dynamic_weight_bridge: preserved and separately covered by focused tests; default remains off

next_target_neutral_requirement.mechanism: attach an ordered runtime per-channel quantized-epilogue value to convolution results, with explicit accumulator encoding/layout and a legal fused-host fallback
next_target_neutral_requirement.smallest_gemmini_adapter_step: prove compute-only LOOP_CONV accumulator layout and emit an explicit full-width accumulator MVOUT into the existing exact one-pass runtime-scale host readout
next_target_neutral_requirement.expected_first_win: delete scalar row-im2col packing and its synchronization without changing PT2E quantization; this does not yet delete the full-width boundary
next_target_neutral_requirement.required_for_exact_boundary_deletion: a target implementation of ordered post-accumulation per-channel f32 scale then f32 bias then activation/rounding, or a separately authorized quantization-contract change
forbidden_shortcuts: convert non-integral f32 bias to accumulator bias
use one scalar scale for per-channel scales
import TVM/model constants or layer names
reuse the q536 model-specific stitcher or TVM host

limitations.performance_claim: real generic micro codegen and warm correctness; zero additional full-ResNet performance over q535
